behavior.arguments: rdi is the only pointer argument read (rdi+8 dereferenced); no other argument is read
behavior.branch_order: first comparison branches (jne) to the ret with eax still 0 when the first field is nonzero; otherwise the second comparison sets al; no calls inside the window
behavior.output_shape: rax is fully determined (xor %eax,%eax before both comparisons): 1 or 0, then ret

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

naming_relocation.note: data-pointer reference only, applied at load time; not a direct call
